verdict.rationale: TaxJar automates filing and remittance through AutoFile, so asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. The evidence pack shows no such capability. The 'x-api-version' header pins the API version, not user automations, and the 'Archive of historical sales tax data' is a data archive rather than automation version history, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
